notes: Stories created for Provider Quality Snapshot with full lifecycle coverage.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S1.title: Define Provider Quality Snapshot Schema and Contract
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S1.description: Define structured schema for provider quality snapshot including credential, specialty, license state, status, enumeration date, and address based on NPI registry fields.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S2.title: Implement Provider Quality Extraction and Mapping Logic
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S2.description: Extract and normalize NPI registry data fields from provider_detail_service and map them into the defined quality snapshot schema, handling missing or inconsistent values.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S3.title: Expose Provider Quality Snapshot via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S3.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include provider quality snapshot in provider detail responses, ensuring compatibility with existing tool routing and response structures.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Quality Snapshot
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S4.description: Create unit tests for schema validation and mapping logic, and integration tests to verify end-to-end flow from NPI lookup through facade response.
